title: Black Emperor City
summary: Xiao Yan frees the hostages, and the Fourth Elder of Demon Flame Valley dies in Little Fairy Doctor's poison gas. After seeing the students to safety, Xiao Yan, Little Fairy Doctor and Zi Yan enter Black Emperor City under the name Yan Xiao. A Black Emperor Sect guard sends them to the Black Emperor Pavilion and warns them about the Kui Wolf Gang. At the Thousand Medicinal House, Xiao Yan buys herbs and wants three rare ones in exchange for a Fifth-Tier Pill. Qi Shan, chief alchemist of the Black Emperor Sect, wants the same herbs, and both offer a Fighting Spirit Pill. Xiao Yan's pill is better, and he wins the herbs and makes an enemy of Qi Shan. The shop's alchemist tells him the Bodhisattva Body Transformation Saliva will be sold at the auction.
